name: Primal Passions: Isekai Love
source:
Whisked away from your ordinary life into a breathtaking world where it really is survival of the fittest, you discover that your arrival was foretold—that you alone are destined to unite the tribal beast men clans. Each of these rival groups holds secrets, powers, and a handsome leader intent on vying for your heart. As you confront dark forces and ancient prophecies, will you be able to bring harmony to this divided land and ignite true love in the wilderness of your heart?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.isekaibeastman]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
远离平凡的生活，进入一个真正的适者生存的令人惊叹的世界，你发现你的到来是被预言的——只有你注定要团结兽人部族。这些敌对团体中的每一个都拥有秘密、权力和一位英俊的领导者，一心想要争夺你的心。当你面对黑暗势力和古老的预言时，你能否为这片分裂的土地带来和谐，并在你内心的荒野中点燃真爱？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.isekaibeastman]Google Play[/url]]
